newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Cholera kills 24 in Ivory Coast's main prison.
newsitem.headline: Cholera kills 24 in Ivory Coast's main prison.

text.p: A cholera outbreak in Abidjan's main prison killed 24 inmates and another 150 had been hospitalised, the head of the prison service said in an interview published on Tuesday.

Francois Guei told the Ivory Coast government daily, Fraternite-Matin, that the outbreak began on June 23 and was caused by inmates drinking water meant for the gardens, despite being warned not to by prison staff.
"The epidemic really grieves me in that it has just wiped out all the efforts made by the authorities to improve prison conditions," Guei said.
He admitted the prison was overcrowded -- built to hold 1,500 prisoners, it currently has 5,462 -- but denied that that played a big part in the cholera outbreak.
Guei said 68 people remained in hospital but, since there had been no deaths reported since Saturday, the doctors believed the situation was now under control.
